releases.displayName: Huge Patch! Tons of bug fixes and Balance Patches! Discord League News!

items.text: Hi everyone! We're excited to bring you the latest major update for Two Strikes. This patch includes numerous bug fixes and significant balance adjustments for many characters.
Unfortunately for Musashi, we ended up letting some pretty serious bugs escape, making him a nightmare to fight against and sometimes impossible to beat.

Defending his dash forward was not triggering a reaction from him, stopping the DF animation, basically allowing players to spam it until the match as over. Since it would not trigger perfect parries as well.
Musashi was not reacting to Yasuke's parry breaker ability.
Musashi's hurtbox was moving after some playtime, making him invulnerable after some time.
When Musashi dashes back, if he is too close to the opponent, then it would not move him back.
Fixed Yasuke's walk animation hurtbox being moved forward and triggering unfair hits on him.
Fixed Ayai not hitting another Ayai with the second heavy attack if the attack was launched up close.
Fix bug where Kenji, after being perfectly parried, was not being punished by quick attacks like Ayai's light attack.
Extended Goemon’s kunai hurtbox backwards to make sure that characters too close to him get hit by it.
Fixed when Dash Forward attacks generated a clash, the clash would repeat.
(Offline only) Fix parry input not taking precedence over moving.
(Online only) Removed the ability of Ayai to cancel their light attacks.
(Online only) Fixed the direction of the Blood VFX when Musashi died.
(Online only) Fixed that some characters were not triggering a second VFX when getting the second hit, like Tomoe.
(Online only) Fixed that the Shinigami didn’t have a lot of his sound effects online.
(Online only) Some character combinations would shift the initial position on the screen.
(Online only) Fixed the issue with joining rooms after changing regions once.
(Online only) Fixed hurtbox problems with Miyo and Shenyan
(Online only) Fixed that the Underground Arena and Secret Laboratory were not appearing online.
This patch focuses on bringing some characters that are being considered lower tiers and making them more viable.
The old man is the one seeing more buffs this patch.
Perfect parry window increased by 1 frame.
Heavy Attack recovery is reduced by 5 frames.
Walking speed increased 10%.
Heavy feint sped up by 50%.
The psycho samurai is seeing some nerfs on this patch.
Dash forward attack duration increased by 3 more frames at the end, making it less spammable.
Light attack is also seeing an increase in 3 more frames at the end.
Musashi cannot cancel his light attack anymore. It is a very fast attack that allows unfair mixups.
Walking speed
The strongest teenager alive is getting a good buff to his dodge.
Dodge animation is 3 frames faster now, allowing you to recover faster from it.
This is the first time he is seeing nerfs in the game.
Light attack preparation is 3 frames slower now.
Light attack recovery is also 3 frames slower.
Kenji’s light attack has been a menace to the meta, being a great snipping tool.
Hozoin’s good old rival is also getting stronger, since he cannot even imagine losing to Hozoin.
Added 2 more rope spins to the heavy attack animation, allowing him to continue to get closer for longer, making it more difficult for opponents to simply move out of range.
Everybody’s favorite girl is getting nerfed yet again.
Added 6 frames to her heavy attack recovery, making sure she can be punished if players miss it.
With 2 tournaments hapenning every week, one for US and another for the EU region, we finally got our first Shogun of the server. An honor dedicated to the best of the best:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40503590/6bd538150c18b01b3c4381d540d4ec5c0c6a104f.jpg"]
Add sound effect when a player gets a perfect parry.
Fixed a bug where the songs were repeating after each "Strike or Die"
Dash's forward could dodge some horizontal attacks. Now she should be vulnerable to horizontal and vertical attacks while dash forward attacking.
Hurtbox for his strong attack defended recovery is now vulnerable to all attacks as well.
Tomoe's dash back and the recovery from being strong defended is now also vulnerable to horizontal attacks.
Fixed simplified and traditional localization keys for the story mode and profiling of the characters. Fixed also some other localisations.

Hey all! First of all, I really want to show my appreciation for the best Discord community a game could have. It's beautiful how you all love the game and are a key part of this game, sharing feedback, reporting bugs, and being really amazing to each other. If you're not part of it yet, join us!
I hope you've been enjoying the game so far. We've been working a lot these last couple of weeks, and after the amazing feedback from our community as we have a PACKED patch notes for version 1.0.2.
Buckle up because we have a lot of things to talk about.

Perfect Parry was not working well. Some of the hits you have all been getting should have been perfect parries instead, and it is finally fixed, making the usage of parry finally reliable. This will give a big boost, especially to those characters with longer parry preparation.
Inputs were being eaten while walking. Sometimes, trying to attack or parry while walking was not working.
Perfect Parries should have sent the defender to the Idle Animation. Instead, it was sending them to the weak or strong recovery, missing the whole point of the reward of perfect parrying.
Perfect Parry was not working after the first one. This would happen after successfully perfecting parrying an opponent.
Button rebinding was not working for the online mode.
The screen continues shaking after hit.
In the middle of arcade mode, the menus were popping for no reason.
Toggling cross-platform was crashing the game if the player was trying to come back from any single-player mode, after reaching Warrior Selection.
Dash's forward distance was different from her offline counterpart. Adjusted to be the same.
Fixed weird hitbox allowing crazy long-ranged hits.
Hurtbox for his dash forward attack was adjusted to to get hits on low opponent's animations, like Tomoe's and Ayai's animations.
Hurtbox on his strong attack was also expanded to get opponents close or touching his sprite.
Her strong feint and strong attack hitboxes were expanded vertically to avoid weird whiffs from the opponent's horizontal attacks.
Tomoe's second weak attack hurtbox got expanded vertically to make sure she could hit some low animations, like Miyo and Ayai.
After defending a strong attack the animation was not the same as the offline version, leading him to be unable to punish some attacks, like Tomoe's strong attack, after defending it.
Miyo's strong attack got his jump back changed to be a lot faster, allowing her to actually react and escape some lunging attacks from the roster.
This also means that the strong feint was also buffed to fulfill the purpose of being used as a dodge mechanism.
Region Selector: You can finally choose the server you wanna play. We will provide options for optimal play all over the world.
Fixed simplified and traditional localization keys for the story mode and profiling of the characters.
We are running bi-weekly tournaments for Europe, North America and soon East Asia.
(Western World Tournament)
(Americas)
(Europe)
The release is here! Enjoy!
Team Duel mode was broken and is now fixed.
Tomoe's last piece of lore was not correct.
Hi everyone, small patch here.
The Story Mode is not finished. I accidentally left it unlocked. I hope this doesn't upset you too much.
It will be back once I finish it.
Danilo Barbosa

releases.displayName: Shenyan, The Drunken Pirate Steals the Update!

notes.title: Today is a glorious day for Two Strikes!

items.text: The Eighth Character arrives in the game! Shenyan, the Druken Wokou!

Shenyan is an insane character, not gonna lie to you! Don't let his age of Death trick you into thinking he's a nice old man. He is here in purgatory for his insatiable blood lust focused on one thing only: Creating misery for Hozoin. You see, they are long long-time acquaintance, childhood friends. But now, any of this matters anymore. You have to wait for the Lore to be ready to know why, sorry.
This drunken pirate has one of the fastest walk speeds and dashes in the entire game. He can get in and out like no other.
Shenyan has two attacks, pretty standard. His trickeries are not in different attacks, but using the ones he has to make everyone very uneasy.
Shenyan's weak attack is fast but has the shortest range in the game, although his strong attack is by far the longest-ranged attack in the game, even beating Hozoin's weak attack.

Shenyan has unique interactions with his Strong Attack. After a start-up animation, he enters a state where he keeps spinning his rope until it is finally released for a powerful attack. During this state, he can:
Press again Strong Attack to cut it short and release it earlier.
Press Weak Attack to use it in case an enemy comes too close.
Dash forwards, to maybe use its Weak Attack.
Or just dash backward, to start all over.
By the power of drunkness, Shenyan can even break game rules, doing whatever he wants with his strong attack.

Thanks to the player @Green, that gave invaluable feedback, I decided to give some buffs to Miyo. He felt, just like me, that She was maybe too deep into deception and lacking a little in some practical uses of her dashes. So,
After the dash forward attack, her recovery has 5 frames less, making her less susceptible to counters.
Her back dash now doesn't have the "attack preparation" animation, making it a lot more reliable to close up the distance.
We are working in the lore and story mode, so soon you will have these things, but before that, enjoy Shenyan.

releases.displayName: New UI and New Input System Update!

items.text: First of all, I'd like to thank the patience for the lack of updates in January, but I promise, it was worth it.
I am happy to announce that we moved away from the old clunky UI to a brand new and beautiful one. With controller or keyboard input indications, for Xbox and PS controllers on all pages.

This UI is not just an aesthetic change, it is laying grounds for all the content that is missing in the game, like extras, achievements, story more lore, and even the ability to listen to the OST of the game in the menus. I am excited about the things to come.
The change also includes all menus, in-game included with a very clear way of communicating the information.

notes.title: I already added a couple of nice things with this new UI

items.text: 1. Credits Screen. Here you can see who has already participated in the game creation and the responsible for all the areas of the game.
2. Default Controller Screen. Here you can see the default inputs for Xbox and PS5 controllers.
3. Options to inactivate the dash with double tapping for each player separately.
4. A more interesting and cohesive key binding screen.
5. The duel settings are not part of the flow anymore. You can set the number of duels or difficulty once and not have to setup every time you choose to play a game mode.
6. New quick guide screen. Here you can access each game tip, instead of having to go through them.
7. News section. Here you will be able to access the latest release notes and any other important Two Strikes news in the future.

In other news, I also had to change the game input system from Rewired to Unity's New Input System. The new UI wasn't compatible with Rewired and as per the request of the publisher, thinking ahead for the porting of the game to all platforms, also suggested I move to the New Input System. This New Input System should simplify detecting fighting sticks and even leverless controllers a lot better and without conflicts with XInput with Steam.
A lot of testing was done to find most of the bugs, but I believe that some of them might have escaped us, so I please asking for your help to find them, so we can squash them as fast as possible.

Ayai recovery after being defended from her weak attack is getting 20% longer since some characters were not able to counter even with a weak attack, which was very unfair considering how fast and long-ranged her attack is.
Yasuke's dash back range is being reduced by 50% and the duration is being decreased by 20%. Consider this a buff, since it makes Yasuke more dynamic and in a better spot after canceling his attacks.

We are getting very close to finishing all the art assets of the game. Including ending illustrations. While I can't show the ending illustrations, I can show you the story mode portraits that were just finished. Miyo, the swordsmith!
I decided to work a little bit more on Infinite Mode before completely focusing again on the Story Mode. Now I think I can do that.
Infinite Mode death counter. Now you can see in real time how many have you dueled to the death.
Last update I decided to remove the Feint (hold) input, but upon requests, I decided to re-add again.
Getting hit in Infinite doesn't reset at the start of the next match, making it a lot more difficult to reach higher scores.

topNew: Infinite Mode death counter. Now you can see in real time how many have you dueled to the death.

releases.displayName: Another HUGE update! New gameplay mechanic! Difficulties, Localization!

items.text: Hey! How are you all doing lately?

Well, I've been working very quietly this last month. There are some reasons behind it. The main one was that May was a very stressful month. I've been to 3 gaming festivals with Two Strikes, and by the end of it, I was basically dead! haha! June brought no updates until now because I needed some resting, although, working on the game can be a nice way to rest as well, so I continue working this whole month without telling you much. The result wasn't bad, I must tell. I'm very excited to bring to you everything I did this month:

This is another game-changing mechanic! Just like the perfect parry it gives the players a whole new range of options. Differently from dash canceling, the feint mechanic doesn't move the player. Allowing a brand new range of mind games.

The feint mechanic seems very simple. The broad idea is that it will fake an attack. How does it work? it plays half of the preparation animation for the attack and stops, going back to idle, and releasing some smoke. This creates new opportunities for baiting defenses and new attack timings making the fighters even more unpredictable.

Not all attacks can be faked, though. The rule is: all the attacks that can be canceled by dashing, can also be feinted. So for example, Tomoe's strong attack cannot be feinted, but Kenji's strong can.

I've spent the last week completely redoing how the AI defends. It was a tough job, but now I have full control of this aspect, which means I have a lot more freedom to create new difficulties and new behaviours. Are you excited for bigger challenges?
Another thing is long overdue, but it is finally here. The game will count initially with 3 CPU levels.
Level 1: No dash cancels and feints. The CPU shouldn't perfect parry.
Level 2: Can dash cancel. No feints. Small chance of perfect parry.
Level 3: Dash cancels and feints, considerable chance of perfect parry.

This idea is to continue building on it and teach the new player without overwhelming them. In the future, I will be creating more CPU levels and adding new behaviors. I'm very excited about this because the perfect parry and the feint mechanics gave the game so many new layers to the CPUs as well.

A game guide was long overdue... I decided to start with a simple version of it to show newcomers especially all the secrets the game holds, since I was seeing on my trips, in short gameplays they were being difficult to find, giving the player the impression that the game was too simple.
This is only the first iteration, the idea is to add videos and practice gameplay to it in the future.

This was supposed to be added later. But the guide, even though I tried not to make it too lengthy, it ended up having a reasonable amount of text. This ended up pushing me to get this over with. You can now head to Settings and change the language to Spanish, Italian, German and Portuguese (Brazil). Soon more languages are coming, like Portuguese (PT), French, and Catalan. Remember to restart the game once you changed the language to see its effect.

I continue to add voice actors to our beloved characters. This time around, Goemon, Ayai, and Tomoe received their voices, not only in-game but also when winning matches. They are all in Japanese and they tell you a little bit more about their lives and death.
Discord Menu Option

I want to build the best gaming community there is. So I added this menu option to work as a reminder to old players that aren't still in the channel and for the newcomers that always add much life to the community.

As always, there were a lot of these to be fixed. But I ask you to be aware that I might have added some more with the new feint mechanic. If you find any new ones, please let me know. Some of the bugs fixed:
While trying to fix some problems with Ayai, I ended up creating some distancing bugs between other fighters. This should be better now, but not 100% fixed.
Yasuke no longer gets weird hits while walking.

releases.displayName: Huge Performance Update! Remodeled starting menu!

notes.title: Hello duelists! This week is packed with very important updates!

items.text: For the last two weeks, I've been working on remodeling the whole start menu. Adding some key quality-of-life features to the game that was long due.

At the same time, I had some external help from a very dear friend, Rinaldo Bueno, that helped me solve most of the performance issues that were plaguing the players with less powerful machines, making it impossible to play the game after the Ayai Update.
Initial loading times should be drastically reduced because the game is now loading resources gradually and removing them from memory once it is not used.
The starting menu was completely remodeled, and a huge refactor was made making it very easy to add more options to the menus in the future.
New Settings menu option added: Now it is possible to change the resolution that suits the player better.
New fullscreen mode added: Now it is possible to play the game outside fullscreen.
Volume sliders added: Now it is possible to adjust master, music, and sound effects volume.
Support for Nintendo GameCube and Switch Pro controllers added.
Once the player comes back to the menu, it goes straight to the menu options, instead of playing the initial screens again.
Ayai is now properly backfliping back after her weak attack.
It was possible to play an attack animation while dodging, which allowed the character have a faster next attack since the animation would only play the rest of the clip. (Bug reported by Napparatus)
Player 2 could select unfinished characters.

releases.displayName: Ayai is finally here! Two Strikes welcomes the personification of anger!

items.text: Ayai is the fifth character to be added to Two Strikes.
The fastest warrior in the game so far, Ayai can reach her opponents very easily and at the same time fake her lighting-fast attacks like any other character in the game.

Ayai doesn't have strong attacks, but at the same time, she possesses two quick weak attacks that are very difficult to be defended. Her dash forward travels a great distance and her dash back is a key weapon to mix with the attack cancels making her an unpredictable force of nature.
Being Ayai extremely agile, controlling her might not be the easiest thing in the game, so, mastering her takes time but it will be worth it.
Being so fast also brings other disadvantages. Being defended creates huge holes in her defense, becoming easy prey for counter-attacks, so, be careful and time your attacks well!

Ayai was born in a small village by the edge of the Amano River as the sixth daughter of the clan chief. She had a mostly peaceful early life, with a loving father and mother. She originally trained to be the daughter of the chief, but as she grew older, became fascinated with the blades and bows of the hunters of her village. She loved stories, especially the story of Sitonai, the Snake Hunter.
More later in the upcoming story more...

Casual Mode added. This is the first step to the training mode a lot of players requested. For now, you can choose the AI enemy you want to practice against, but this will be evolving in the next updates.

Blood Spurts: Visual indicator for weak hits. Some players complained about the lack of indication when they were getting hit. I hope this fixes the problem without adding UI to take the focus of the action.
Sound effects remastered. We have here a full revision of the SFXs we had it previously.
New dash effects.
There were so many bug fixes in this period without updates that are very hard to map all of the ones that were fixed in the update. Some of them are:
Hozoin AI working properly
Hozoin sprites weren't full HD for some animations.
We are still working on the game.

I'm really sorry about the many many delays. Most of them are related with the fact we were only counting with one artist and it was too much for him. We had to renegotiate his contract and I've hired two more artist to help me with the project.

Right now we are working on 4 remaining characters, 2 more maps, 2 more songs, game modes, achievement screens at the same time we are still talking with publishers. Just to be clear, for the vanilla release there will be 8 characters, 8 maps and 8 stage musics.

I'm trying to get a better estimation from when I will have all the finalised characters to finally start to release new content. I want to avoid casual releases and new hiatuses. I ask again for patience since we are indie developers and we want nothing less of releasing this game as soon as possible.

About the multiplayer online. Without the full content of the game, it's been impossible to attract a publisher that could help us with that. (I don't have the expertise to create a good online experience).

I'm very hopeful that once we finally have everything in place, probably in the next 3 months. We will be able to advertise the game and get the attention we need to finally get some answers for that.

I'm really sorry for the lack of information also. I was trying to get a clearer idea of a release date to finally communicate better instead of just communicating excuses which I imagine all the players are tired of listen to it.
We are working hard on the game, don't doubt it. The next two months will be crucial to determine a release date and the pursuit of a suiting publishing partner. I hope you continue to believe in us.
Best regards,
Danilo Barbosa, Retro Reactor Games.
